summary: AGL Private Credit Income Fund, a closed-end private credit BDC-style vehicle, filed an 8-K reporting the September 28, 2026 closing of a $70,000,000 drawdown capital call, issuing 2,988,898.38 common shares at an implied $23.42 per share under existing subscription agreements, exempt via Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. The drawdown notice was delivered September 14, 2026 with 10-day minimum notice. Item 7.01 disclosed approximately $292.6 million of new post-June 30 commitments (weighted average spread 5.2%, 40.4% LTV), $243.7 million initially funded. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or deal terms; routine capital-call and portfolio-update disclosure, not a special situation.
